title: Publish the P0 roadmap evidence-hardening outputs
instruction: Spend approximately six hours improving the six P0 roadmaps into an evidence-hardened provisional release. Re-audit all milestones and public sources, distinguish observed events, as-of baselines, forward-looking targets, Coverage Gaps, and OpenFS provisional gates, expose roadmap dependencies and three HPCI planning scenarios, prepare an independent-model Consensus review package, improve the harness and validation, publish only public information, and do not fill missing evidence by inference.
